core_obligations: Rewrite L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B' as a lower shriek using the cotangent complex computation and the change-of-rings lemma (proof lines 1211-1222).
Use flatness of the differential sheaf to compute the pullback as the corresponding sheaf of the primed square (proof lines 1223-1230).
Apply the flat base change statement for lower shrieks together with the computation of L_{B'/A'} to conclude (proof lines 1231-1233).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if the commutative square induces a quasi-isomorphism B tensor_A^L A' = B', then the functoriality map induces an isomorphism L_{B/A} tensor_B^L B' -> L_{B'/A'} (source lines 1201-1209). The proof identifies the left hand side with the lower shriek of a pullback: the computation of the cotangent complex writes L_{B/A} as Lpi_! of the differential sheaf tensored with B, and the change-of-rings lemma rewrites the derived tensor product with B' as the lower shriek along h of the pullback of that sheaf. Flatness of the sheaf of differentials then computes that pullback as the corresponding sheaf for the primed square, and the flat base change statement for lower shrieks plus the computation of L_{B'/A'} finish the identification.
